translation_snapshot.source: Whilst wearing leather or lighter armour, you gain %d%% Defense and %d%% Armour hardiness.
translation_snapshot.target: 当你身着轻甲或更轻的护甲时，你会增加 %d%% 闪避和 %d%% 护甲强度。

translation_snapshot.source: @Source@ rushes out, claws sharp and ready!

Superior cunning and training allows you to outthink and outwit your opponents' physical and mental assaults.  Increases Defense by %d and Mental Save by %d.
		The Defense bonus will scale with your Dexterity, and the save bonus with your Cunning.
translation_snapshot.target:
卓越的灵巧与训练使你能以智取胜，看穿并化解对手的肉体和精神攻击。增加 %d 近身闪避和 %d 精神豁免。
		受敏捷影响，闪避按比例加成；受灵巧影响，精神豁免按比例加成。

translation_snapshot.source:
Corrupted vapour rises at the target location (radius 4) doing %0.2f blight damage every turn for %d turns.
		The damage increases with Spellpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
腐化的蒸汽在目标位置升起（半径 4），每回合造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害，持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: You cannot use Sweep without dual wielding!
translation_snapshot.target: 你只有在双持状态下才能使用横扫！

translation_snapshot.source:
You are able to perform usually unstealthy actions (attacking, using objects, ...) without breaking stealth.	 When you perform such an action while stealthed, you have a chance to stay hidden.
		Success is more likely against fewer opponents and is determined by comparing %0.2f times your stealth power (currently %d) to the stealth detection (reduced by 10%% per tile distance) of all enemies that have a clear line of sight to you.
		Your base chance of success is 100%% if you are not directly observed, and good or bad luck may also affect it.
		You estimate your current chance to maintain stealth as %0.1f%%.
translation_snapshot.target:
你学会在潜行状态下执行一些通常会打破潜行的行动（如攻击、使用物品……）。当你在潜行状态下这么做的时候，你有一定概率不会打破潜行状态。
		面对的对手越少，成功率越高；你的成功率取决于你潜行强度的 %0.2f 倍（当前值 %d）， 以及所有视线能及你的敌人的侦测潜行能力（离你距离每有一格则下降10%%）。
		当你不在敌人的视野内时，基础成功率为 100%%，这一几率还受你的运气影响。
		你估计当前成功率为 %0.1f%%。

translation_snapshot.source: Each time one of your foes bites the dust, you feel a surge of power, increasing your strength by 2 (stacking up to a maximum of %d) for %d turns.
translation_snapshot.target: 每当你让一个敌人扑街，你会感到一股力量涌起，增加你 2 点力量，上限 %d， 持续 %d 回合。

translation_snapshot.source: Start to sever the lifeline of the target. After 4 turns, if the target is still in line of sight of you, its existance will be ended (%d temporal damage).
translation_snapshot.target: 开始离断目标的生命线。4 回合后，如果目标仍在你的视线内，它的存在将被终结 （%d 时空伤害）。

translation_snapshot.source:
A punch to the body that deals %d%% damage, drains %d of the target's stamina per combo point, and dazes the target for %d to %d turns, depending on the amount of combo points you've accumulated.
		The daze chance will increase with your Physical Power.
		Using this talent removes your combo points.
translation_snapshot.target:
对目标的身体发出强烈的一击，造成 %d%% 伤害，每点连击点消耗 %d 目标体力并眩晕目标 %d 到 %d 回合（由你的连击点数决定）。
		眩晕概率受物理强度加成。
		使用此技能会消耗当前所有连击点。

translation_snapshot.source:
Engulfs your hands (and weapons) in a sheath of frost, dealing %0.2f cold damage per melee attack and increasing all cold damage by %d%%.
		The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
将你的双手（及武器）笼罩在寒冰之中，每次近战攻击造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害，并提高 %d%% 寒冷伤害。
		效果受法术强度加成。
